purpose: Open development monitoring of known insulin temporal biology while preserving a separate prospective validation path.

all_must_hold: all relevant unit, isolation, and canonical non-regression tests pass
production output contains no benchmark truth, anchor ID, locked score, expected kinase, or known temporal label
canonical Wave, TMM coefficients, and kinase ranking remain byte/semantic equivalent under the same frozen input unless an independently justified change is separately reviewed
existing Dynamic Co-Wave v2 acceptance ledger passes
current transition_resolution is never labeled as temporal-order support when its exact diagnostic is non-significant
condition-level temporal records are never represented as replicate uncertainty or causal evidence

known_insulin_noninferiority.denominator_rule: An increased percentage is not an improvement when its evaluable denominator decreases; numerator and denominator must both be reported.

acceptance_rules.adoption_rule: A candidate satisfying all mandatory rules but not improving an evaluable known-insulin endpoint is instrumentation-only. It cannot be described as a biological performance improvement.
acceptance_rules.rejection_rule: Reject any candidate that raises a score by using known labels, expected temporal windows, benchmark reference identifiers, RAG text, LLM output, or inhibitor outcomes in production analysis.

evaluation_sequence: run locked scorer only after archival
run exact time-index diagnostic separately from locked scorer
record runtime, coverage, denominator, status, and test outcomes in iteration ledger
compare to frozen baseline without overwriting the baseline
use prospective perturbation cohort for confirmatory performance claims

interpretation.known_insulin_status: open development monitor; not an independent final performance test after iterative engineering use
interpretation.future_confirmation: Trametinib primary factorial cohort followed by mirdametinib chemical holdout
interpretation.unknown_candidate_policy: Future unknown candidates are not selected in this iteration, but contracts must retain provenance, missingness, counterevidence, and uncertainty so they can later be prioritized without retraining on benchmark truth.
